verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a credential vault, automated TOTP/2FA completion, or keeping secrets hidden from the model. Profiles persist cookies and storage across sessions, but that is an adjacent session-reuse feature, not vault-backed login with 2FA. CAPTCHA solving is likewise a different capability.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can store credentials in a vault and have the agent complete logins including TOTP/2FA challenges without exposing secrets to the model
